title: Chart quiz #12
caption:
Chart quiz #12. Lock in your answers before the reveal.

Q1: Name the pattern
Q2: Pullback, or reversal?
Q3: What does the volume say?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #ChartPatterns #PriceAction #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Patterns, pullbacks and volume. Question one. Three peaks, with the middle one highest. What's the pattern? Head and shoulders, cup and handle, or double bottom? Head and shoulders. A left shoulder, a higher head, a lower right shoulder, and then the neckline gave way. It's a bearish pattern, but only once that neckline breaks. Question two. A strong uptrend, and now price is dipping toward its average. Is this a pullback, or a reversal? A pullback. Volume dried up on the dip, and it held above the last higher low. A reversal usually breaks that low. Question three. Price broke above resistance. Look at the volume bars. Does the volume confirm the move, or warn against it? It confirms it. Volume more than doubled on the breakout candles. Lots of traders joined the move, and it kept going. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
